name: Noise dissolve logomark
looks: A mark or name condenses into being from a scatter of loose points rather than dropping or wiping in, with the points arriving at different times so the shape visibly fills in as the last ones land.
build: Sample the mark into seeded points by drawing it to an offscreen canvas and reading its filled pixels on a grid; ease each point from a seeded start position to its target with a seeded delay, ramping its opacity up as it nears the target, and crossfade to the crisp vector mark in the final moment.
sound: A shimmer that resolves into a soft hit as the mark completes.
prompt: Condense a mark or name into solid form out of a loose scatter of points drifting in from different directions and times, rather than having it drop or wipe on. Use this as a brand's opening identity beat or its closing signature, sitting between a harder assemble and a full end-card reveal.
source: a brand reveal in prompt-motion.com's gallery, studied 2026-10-07.
